dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge with a steep inward spline curve descending from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius, transitioning into a backward-tilting profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a moderate-to-high angular steepness relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 (base width to vertical height ratio).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable white notch or depigmented lesion on the posterior-upper section of the dorsal fin trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive presence of white water droplets or superficial skin nodules across the dorsal surface, and a visible diagonal pale blaze or 'saddle' patch on the lateral flank.
